content.text:
The bug (only filename shown, no relative path) was introduced when commit 888867c changed `tempPath` from the full relative path (`path.toString().replaceAll(location+separator,"")`) to just `fileName.toString()` (the filename only, via `path.getFileName()`).

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 888867c602e6969d278f2f7f141004c3bd7d1b38

## Reasoning
(1) I ran `git log --follow -p` on `FileHandler.java` to see the full history of the `fileMatcher` method, since that's the method touched by the fix commit.

(2) The fix commit c05dbd1 changes `String tempPath = fileName.toString();` to `String tempPath = location.relativize(path).toString();`, restoring the relative path instead of just the bare filename. Looking at the immediately preceding commit 888867c ("Use Path instead of Strings to avoid OS-specifics"), it refactored the code from:
```java
String tempPath = (path.toString().replaceAll(location + File.separator, "")).toLowerCase();
```
to:
```java
Path fileName = path.getFileName();
if (pathMatcher.matches(fileName)) {
    String tempPath = fileName.toString();
```
This is exactly the regression: before 888867c, `tempPath` was the full path with the base location stripped out (i.e., relative path, including subdirectories). After 888867c, it became just the last path component (`path.getFileName()`), discarding any subdirectory structure — matching the bug description "only showed the filename without suffix" (path segments lost, leaving nothing but a bare name).

(3) The evidence is a direct, isolated diff: only one commit sits between the fix and the pre-bug state on this line, and it is the commit that swapped `path`-relative string handling for `path.getFileName()`. No other commits touched this line in between. Confidence is high.
